description: Expiries of one underlying traded on a date, per instrument, with contracts, open interest and strike counts. Required: symbol. date defaults to the latest day with data, and snaps back to the last trading day on or before it. End of day NSE equity derivatives from 2010-01-04, no BSE, no intraday. Tier: needs a Retail or Pro key (https://tejhq.dev/upgrade).

date.description: Trading date. Default: latest. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Use meta.next_offset from a truncated result.

symbol.description: Underlying symbol, for example NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, RELIANCE. Case does not matter.

name: fo_expiries
title: F&O expiries on a date
